neighbours.label: first sub-token of a multi-token proper name (Burn|aby, Hear|ne, Row|an, Arg|us) when the name is mentioned again later in the passage
fire: Burnaby was a quiet suburb when the family arrived. Her father opened a bakery, and within a year most of Burnaby knew his rye bread.
Hearne kept a careful journal on the march north. The traders doubted the story, but Hearne produced maps to prove it.
Rowan was founded as a teachers' college. Alumni give generously because they feel Rowan changed their lives.
Rockwood arrived in the valley with a survey crew. The investors hesitated, yet Rockwood promised them water within two years.
Browne turned professional late. Sponsors ignored him for years, but last summer Browne won his first major.
The Argus implant was approved a decade ago. Patients now worry about who will repair Argus devices when they fail.
Converse once dominated basketball shoes. By the time Nike bought the company, Converse had nearly vanished from the courts.
Hedgehog signalling guides the growth of the embryo. In several tumours, researchers found that Hedgehog genes were switched back on.
